cases.title: Tuning a MuJoCo model inside a 48K budget

cases.title: Writing Vim macros for a million-row CSV inside a 48K budget
cases.description: Four editing turns, three of them after a soft reminder, keep a long Vim-macro search at a 40.2K-token peak while the unedited history reaches 50.0K, past the 48K budget.

reminders.soft: [context-monitor] Your context has grown sizeable; this is a good moment to tidy it up. If anything in it is no longer needed, condense or remove all of it in one pass — clear out everything that has served its purpose and leave the rest untouched; do not trim a little and save the rest for later. If there is very little worth cleaning up, or everything is still in use, you may explain why and decline — that is a reasonable choice.
reminders.hard: [context-monitor] Your context is close to its limit and must be cleaned up now. Before anything else this turn, condense or remove everything that is no longer needed — clear all of it out and leave what you still rely on untouched. This is not optional; only if there is genuinely nothing that can be cleaned up may you explain why and skip it.
